scope: Local uncommitted implementation; no production deployment, real repository activation, paid inference, commit or push.

full_backend.command: cd backend && uv run python -m pytest -q
full_backend.boundary: Completed before final locked-row refresh, activation recheck, terminal-retention, packfile-monitor and sanitized job-error refinements; the final 126-case graph suite covers those changes and three added cases.

final_graph_suite.command: cd backend && uv run python -m pytest -q tests/test_code_graph_workflow.py tests/test_code_graph_storage.py tests/test_code_graph_parser.py

validation.migration: Isolated DB downgrade/upgrade preservation and graph metadata comparison passed; development upgraded additively to 20261026_graph_jobs.
validation.public_contract: OpenAPI export and bun run api:types passed with no generated public type diff.
validation.build: Application Docker build passed, including tsc and Vite; existing bundle-size warning remains.
validation.compose: Production, development and Coolify profile checks passed; graph source volume is mounted only on the review worker.
validation.development: Workers drained before restart; 13 services running, API readiness and frontend HTTP 200, all 5 Celery workers ping, no tracebacks/error lines in inspected startup logs.

preserved_records.method: Counts and SHA-256 digests of sorted primary keys match before/after.

validation.real_container_smoke: UID 10001 can write graph volume; synthetic bare Git commit -> manifest -> actual private parser -> exact retained blob -> graph-ref pruning passed. Temporary fixture removed.

boundaries: GitHub permissions, token issuance and acquisition are stubbed in workflow tests; actual Git object storage, PostgreSQL and Redis are exercised.
Container smoke uses synthetic source and does not publish a database snapshot.
Full parser CPU/memory/network/destructive resource acceptance remains the separate Phase 1B evidence; unchanged parser isolation was not stress-tested again.
No live GitHub acquisition, public graph API, MCP code tools, browser graph controls, hosted CI or full-stack 8 GB benchmark.
Disk limits are polled (256 MiB/repository, 1 GiB/instance), not filesystem quotas; the store requires a shared POSIX-lock-capable volume.
